countDefinitions.merged: A PR counts as merged only when fresh API merged === true and merged_at is non-null.
countDefinitions.authoredMerged: Only Afloat16-authored original/replacement PRs whose own API record is actually merged. A closed original continued by a maintainer does not count.
countDefinitions.independentlyLanded: One per original/replacement improvement if its own PR or a mapped canonical/alternate continuation is actually merged; duplicate continuation PRs count at most once.
countDefinitions.contributionCredit: Actual upstream merge_commit authorship/coauthor only. Successor branch/head authorship is not treated as the final main commit author.
countDefinitions.retired: Rejected FIFO #50588 remains in original publication status counts but is retired from active candidate scope; replacement #50754 is counted separately as a submitted candidate.
countDefinitions.qualification: Publication and maintainer statements such as 'landed' are not themselves merge evidence.
countDefinitions.followupLimit: An actually merged contribution can still require follow-up corrections. The merged count does not certify that all subsequent review findings are resolved.

newActionableTechnicalFeedback.author: coderabbitai[bot]
newActionableTechnicalFeedback.summaryZh: 预览尾部扫描以存在 text block 计数；whitespace-only、hidden-context-only 或 visual-directive-only 文本会被前向预览归一化丢弃，却可提前耗尽扫描预算，使更早的有效预览未被读取。
newActionableTechnicalFeedback.requestedChange: Use the same accepted-preview normalization/predicate as the forward preview path when counting the preview budget.

currentMainVerification.verificationLevel: Read-only static verification at exact current main; this audit did not run a new behavioral reproduction.

newActionableTechnicalFeedback.status: Root acknowledged and assigned to parser for a verified two-file compatible follow-up plus production-entry regression; root will run explicit red/green proof and complete exact-source gate. No source or remote action by this audit.
newActionableTechnicalFeedback.commentBody:
** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Count only text that the preview path accepts when bounding the preview scan.** `readOpenCodePreviewTail` stops after six messages whose blocks contain any `text` block. The forward preview path rejects some of that text. Whitespace-only text, hidden-context-only text, and visual-directive-only text produce no preview in `addPreviewMessage`. A run of such messages can stop the reverse scan before it reaches earlier messages with usable text. Those earlier parts are never read, so their previews are lost and the listing falls back to summary text or no preview. Use the same normalization in the predicate that the forward path uses:
Suggested fix

```diff -import { normalizeTitleText } from '../../parsing/session-scanner-text-normalization' +import { + extractPreviewContentText, + normalizeTitleText +} from '../../parsing/session-scanner-text-normalization' ``` ```diff const { blocks } = decodeSessionMessage(role, content, null, { includeTools: false }) - if (blocks.some((block) => block.kind === 'text')) { + const textParts = blocks.flatMap((block) => (block.kind === 'text' ? [block.text] : [])) + if (extractPreviewContentText(textParts, role) !== null) { previews++ } ```
newActionableTechnicalFeedback.assignmentSource: Root follow-up message after this audit observation window.
